title: flaky? cli stored-references bind CONTROL answered empty stdout in 16 ms in merge queue run 43341064666, green on the same shard in the next group
body:
domain:server#8 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwqTK71kjQzHae8T5J

**Suspected new flake: a proposal, not a ledger entry** (first sighting; landing rules: only a human upgrades the triage ledger).

## Signature

Merge-queue run 43341064666 (group `9fa8b571f9`, PR #32935), Test Core (7/8), step "Run this shard's tests":

`@objectstack/cli:test: FAIL integration src/commands/migrate/stored-references.integration.test.ts > os migrate stored-references bind > CONTROL: a database of one package has nothing to bind — AssertionError: expected { unparsed: '' } to match object { outcome: 'refused', …(2) }`

The failing case returned in 16 ms with empty stdout; it normally takes about 700 ms. It reads like the command never started or its output was not captured, not a changed answer.

## Evidence it is not the PR's change

- The next merge group, run 43341397266 (`487ed86a52`, whose only parent is `9fa8b571f9`), ran the same file on the same shard (Test Core 7/8, job 131611332408): 12/12 green, that CONTROL case 728 ms.
- The bind command and the stored-package-references source call nothing unique/duplicate-related; PR #32935 touches no `packages/cli` file.
- No other recent merge_group run failed Test Core (7/8) on this file (13 failed runs checked).

## Do

Find why the CLI child process can return empty stdout this fast under shard load (spawn failure swallowed, stdout not flushed before exit, a race on the temp database), make the test fail loudly with the child's exit code and stderr when stdout is empty, and fix the cause. ⛔ Do not skip or retry the test to get green.
